data.text:
Shiv Prakash Pandey And 16 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.
Secy. Food ... on 16 October, 2024 
Bench: Chief Justice, Jaspreet Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:69591-Db
Chief Justice's Court
Case :- Special Appeal Defective No. - 550 of 2024
Appellant :- Shiv Prakash Pandey And 16 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Food Safety And Drug Admin.Deptt. And 3 Ot
Counsel for Appellant :- Avinash Singh Vishen, Prateek Shrivastava
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C., Anand Kumar Singh (S.C.), Gaurav Mehrotra, Utsav Mishr
Hon'ble Arun Bhansali,Chief Justice
Hon'ble Jaspreet Singh,J. 
1.  Learned counsel for the appellants submits that as the appellants now have been advised that they need to question the validity of the UPSSSC Regulations, 2015, they may be permitted to withdraw the appeal and take steps for questioning the validity of the provisions. 
2. In view of the submissions made, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as aforesaid. 
Order Date :- 16.10.2024 Virendra/Mukesh Pal (Jaspreet Singh, J) (Arun Bhansali, CJ)
